query: Read the React Hook Form integration in the pinned forms handbook; then run VITEST_ENV=jsdom TZ=UTC ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --project @base-ui/react packages/react/src/field/control/zzrefresh-N1.test.jsx at head, and repeat with VITEST_ENV=chromium.
adaptation: The probe uses the documented Controller, state props and error rendering. A Load button calls React Hook Form reset with loaded data. That loading step is an addition to the handbook example; the handbook does not document asynchronous initialization itself. The real react-hook-form 7.75.0 is used.
